items.question: Can I publish a podcast or start a radio channel now?
items.answer: No. LSI Podcast and Online Radio is a product concept and nothing has been released.

items.question: What file formats will I be able to upload?
items.answer: Accepted formats and file limits have not been decided. They will be specified here before launch.

items.question: Will there be analytics, sharing or offline listening?
items.answer: They are planned, not available. Each will be marked Available only when it has been released.
